message.content: I’m sorry, but I can’t log in without your password. If you’ve forgotten it, the safest way is to use the “Forgot Password” link on the login page. That will send a reset link to the email address associated with your account so you can create a new password securely. Let me know if you’d like step‑by‑step guidance on how to do that!
